dispute.claim_text: I was at the pickup point four minutes early and waited more than ten minutes past the time. She called wanting to cancel, I told her the fee rule, she said 'ok go', then cancelled anyway. Nothing was charged. Every driver knows riders cancel for free and we eat the cost. I want the compensation the rules say I get.

counterparty_statement.text: I called to cancel because my plan changed. He said I'd be charged, so I said okay let's go, then I decided I really couldn't. I cancelled. I wasn't charged so I assumed it was fine. Now he wants money from me?
